claim: The one-click sample uses separate temporary state and never changes the real draft.
where: Home sample action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: Seed a real-data sentinel, enter /demo, edit and reset the five-step sample, then start for real and verify the sentinel is unchanged.

claim: Draft content stays in the browser and is not sent away by the editor.
where: Home facts, limits section, privacy page, README
sandbox: Record every request while editing, playing, and exporting the demo; assert that every request is same-origin.

claim: The editor works offline after the first successful visit.
sandbox: Use a fresh browser context, visit /demo, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and verify the five-step sample.

claim: Editing and replay export still work while offline.
sandbox: Use a fresh offline browser context after first load, edit the sample title, download replay HTML, and inspect its content.

claim: Replay export creates one self-contained HTML file.
where: Home how-it-works section, terms page, README
sandbox: Export the demo, verify it has no remote script, stylesheet, or HTTP references, then open and play the file.

claim: Keyboard controls move canvas items and control playback.
sandbox: Focus a demo card, move it with an arrow key, then focus the canvas and start and pause playback with Space.
Open /demo with reduced motion enabled and measure narrative animation and interface transition durations.

claim: Written claim text stays available alongside motion.
sandbox: Move between sample claims and verify each visible canvas state has its written explanation in the live region.

claim: The editor has a usable 390-pixel mobile layout with 44-pixel controls.
sandbox: Open /demo at 390×844, measure page overflow, internal canvas scrolling, replay visibility, and every visible link and button.

claim: The complete editor and replay export are free to use.
sandbox: Edit and export the demo without finding or entering any checkout, purchase, or subscription flow.

claim: Each claim exposes editable start and end timing that agrees with the replay export.
sandbox: Edit a sample interval, check the field, duration, timeline, boundary clamp, and exported value agree.

claim: An editable proof can be downloaded and restored as JSON.
sandbox: Download the demo JSON, change its title, import it, and verify all five claims remain editable.

claim: Clearing this site's browser storage removes the saved draft.
sandbox: Create a real draft after leaving /demo, clear local storage, reload, and verify the editor returns empty.
